name: Succulus
operationalEvidence: Visual p. 103 supplies the table, including one attack at 3d4 and 420 XP. The p. 104 continuation defines touch, detection, resistance, reverse weapon contact and feeding. sourceDiscrepancies: The creature entry calls the two Legacies Dig and Spikes, and uses singular Spike in the combat prose. Digging is the Campaign Book name. This profile uses the appendix’s monster form of Spikes.

name: Swampmare
operationalEvidence: Visual p. 104 distinguishes the claw/claw/bite baseline and the 1d6 Forefeet special attack from the prose’s four-attack sequence in water. Visual p. 105 continues the one-round change and keeps the weapon damage maximum at 1 per round. The appendix overrides the ordinary Plant Form duration with this creature’s six-hour maximum.
sourceDiscrepancies: The printed attack table gives three routine attacks and a separate Forefeet special attack. The combat prose gives four attacks in water without spelling out the individual roll sequence. The 1d6 Forefeet line supplies the damage for the extra attack when applying the water exception.
